purpose: Teach: 末端/因子/ますれ/買い上げ/係数/番外/不振/とりあげ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、末端の犯罪組織にも目を配られますね
lines.en: The police really do keep an eye on even the small criminal networks, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational tone. Steady rhythm. Ends on a gentle upswing—genuine observation, not questioning. Kenji registering respect without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪因子の分析もされますね
lines.en: And they analyze the patterns and causes of crime too, right.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Speaking clearly but not pedantically. Natural pause before the tag-question. Kenji building on his previous point—still genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ご相談ますれば、丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: If someone reaches out to the police, they really do respond carefully, don't they.
lines.style: Soft emphasis on 'carefully.' A slight lean forward in tone—personal appreciation showing through. The cadence of someone who's experienced this care firsthand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の買い上げ価値も算定されますね
lines.en: They even calculate the value of seized goods properly, which is something, isn't it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Small appreciation in the voice for the thoroughness. Even pace. Kenji ticking off another reason to respect the system.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪発生係数を地域別に出されますね
lines.en: They break down crime statistics by area so you can see where problems actually are.
lines.style: Measured, informative. Speaking with the ease of someone who understands the value of data. No rush. Kenji conveying quiet respect for practical methods.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、番外の特別捜査もされますね
lines.en: They even conduct special investigations beyond the usual scope, don't they.
lines.style: Slight lift of interest at the idea. Speaking clearly, with a touch of admiration. Tag-question sits lightly at the end—rhetorical but genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯不振対策を進められますね
lines.en: And they work on local crime prevention strategies even when numbers are down.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Shows understanding of the effort behind preventive work. Kenji recognizing effort that goes unnoticed. Even breath, genuine respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報道にとりあげられた事例も振り返られますね
lines.en: They even look back at cases that have gotten media attention and learn from them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost contemplative. Slower pace. This last point carries a shade more weight—the willingness to review is significant to Kenji. Warm finishing note.
